title: How to Achieve the Intended Aim of Deep Clustering Now, without Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.05749v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep clustering (DC) is often quoted to have a key advantage over $k$-means clustering. Yet, this advantage is often demonstrated using image datasets only, and it is unclear whether it addresses the fundamental limitations of $k$-means clustering. Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC) learns a latent representation via an autoencoder and performs clustering based on a $k$-means-like procedure, while the optimization is conducted in an end-to-end manner. This paper investigates whether the deep-learned representation has enabled DEC to overcome the known fundamental limitations of $k$-means clustering, i.e., its inability to discover clusters of arbitrary shapes, varied sizes and densities. Our investigations on DEC have a wider implication on deep clustering methods in general. Notably, none of these methods exploit the underlying data distribution. translated_title: 如何在不使用深度学习的情况下实现深度聚类的预期目标
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.05749v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：深度聚类（DC）常被引述为相比$k$-均值聚类具有关键优势。然而，这种优势通常仅使用图像数据集来展示，并且尚不清楚它是否解决了$k$-均值聚类的基本局限性。深度嵌入聚类（DEC）通过自编码器学习潜在表示，并基于类似$k$-均值的过程进行聚类，同时以端到端方式优化。本文研究了深度学习的表示是否使DEC能够克服$k$-均值聚类的已知基本局限性，即无法发现任意形状、不同大小和密度的聚类。我们对DEC的研究对一般的深度聚类方法具有更广泛的影响。值得注意的是，这些方法都没有利用底层数据分布。我们发现，一种非深度学习方法实现了深度聚类的预期目标。
tldr: 本文揭示深度聚类方法未利用数据分布，并证明一种非深度学习方法能实现深度聚类的预期目标，从而克服$k$-均值聚类在任意形状、大小和密度聚类上的基本局限。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that deep clustering methods fail to exploit data distribution and demonstrates that a non-deep learning approach can achieve the intended goal of deep clustering, overcoming k-means' fundamental limitations on arbitrary shapes, sizes, and densities.
